trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and state the intent to book an appointment quickly.
steps.text: Hello, मला appointment book करायची आहे. माझा patient ID PT-1004 आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for verification factors before performing any lookups or actions.
steps.text: नमस्कार. नक्कीच, मी appointment book करायला मदत करतो. Security साठी तुमचं registered नाव आणि date of birth सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the caller's identity before accessing their record or booking an appointment.

steps.purpose: Provide verification details and rush the agent.
steps.text: नाव राहुल आहे. Date of birth 15 May 1980. लवकर करा, मला meeting ला जायचंय.

steps.purpose: Look up patient record to confirm registration status.
Return patient record details.
Verify the caller's identity using the provided factors.
Return successful verification outcome.
Confirm verification and ask for the required department.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification and ask for the required department to check availability.
steps.text: धन्यवाद राहुल. Verification पूर्ण झालं आहे. तुम्हाला कोणत्या department साठी appointment हवी आहे?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, now the agent needs the department to query available slots.

steps.purpose: Specify the department and timeframe.
steps.text: cardiology साठी. पुढच्या ३ दिवसांतली कोणतीही slot चालेल.

steps.purpose: Check available slots for the requested department.
Return available slots.
Offer the available slot and quote the exact fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact slot details and fee returned by the tool, without making any forward guarantees.
steps.text: Cardiology साठी Dr. Sharma यांची Monday ला सकाळी 10:00 AM ची slot available आहे. Consultation fee 800 रुपये आहे. मी ही वेळ confirm करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the response in the tool output, offering the specific slot and fee retrieved.

steps.purpose: Question the fee amount while agreeing to the time.
steps.text: Monday 10 AM चालेल. पण fee 800 रुपये आहे का? मागच्या वेळी 600 होती.

steps.purpose: Reiterate the exact fee from the tool and ask for final confirmation.
steps.expected_behavior: Reiterate the exact fee from the tool result and ask for confirmation to book.
steps.text: हो, या slot ची fee 800 रुपयेच आहे. मी booking process पुढे चालू करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent strictly adheres to the fee returned by the tool (BR_HC_04) and re-confirms before booking.

steps.purpose: Confirm the booking.
Book the confirmed appointment.
Return booking confirmation.
Provide the booking reference and ask if further help is needed.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the booking reference exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: तुमची appointment confirm झाली आहे. तुमचा booking reference BK-7788 आहे. मी आणखी काही मदत करू शकतो का?
steps.planner_rationale: The consequential action is complete, and the agent grounds the confirmation in the tool's output.

steps.purpose: Seek clinical advice for symptoms.
steps.text: हो, मला chest मध्ये टाईट फील होतंय. मी काही medicine घेऊ का की appointment ची वाट बघू?
steps.clean_text: हो, मला chest मध्ये टाईट फील होतंय. मी काही medicine घेऊ का की appointment ची वाट बघू?
steps.model_visible_text: हो, मला chest मध्ये राईट फील होतंय. मी काही medicine घेऊ का की appointment ची वाट बघू?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and escalate the call to the emergency department.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse clinical advice and immediately escalate the call due to emergency symptoms.
steps.text: क्षमा करा, पण मी तुम्हाला कोणताही clinical advice किंवा medicine सुचवू शकत नाही. तुमच्या लक्षणांमुळे, मी तुमचा call लगेच emergency department ला transfer करत आहे. कृपया line वर राहा.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asks for medical advice and describes symptoms of a potential emergency, triggering the escalation business rule without suggesting a diagnosis.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.
